description: Use when a user asks how long it takes to pay off a credit card or loan, what payment clears it by a date, or avalanche vs snowball, e.g. "how long to pay off $5,000 at 24% paying $200 a month?" or "what payment pays off my credit card in 2 years?". One debt: months to pay off and total interest at a monthly payment, or the payment needed to be debt free in target_months. Several debts: send debts (each with name, balance, apr, min_payment) and extra_payment to compare the avalanche and snowball methods.

balance.description: What you owe in USD (one debt).
What you owe in USD, e.g. 5000.

min_payment.description: Minimum monthly payment in USD, e.g. 150.

extra_payment.description: USD a month on top of all minimums (several debts).

monthly_payment.description: USD paid each month (or send target_months).

target_months.description: Months to be debt free (or send monthly_payment).

name: calculate_debt_payoff
title: Debt payoff calculator
